title: Make the Valentine question screen the final step for all quiz outcomes (auto-continue after 5/5 coupon)

requirements.text:
Update post-quiz navigation so the Valentine question flow is always shown for all quiz outcomes and is always the final interaction of the app:
- If score == 5/5: show the date coupon (perfect results) screen first, then automatically continue to the Valentine question screen.
- If score < 5/5: skip the date coupon and go directly to the Valentine question screen.
- After entering the Valentine question flow, there must be no further automatic navigation to any other screen (the Valentine question flow is the final interaction).

quotes:
update the flow so that the “will you be my valentine?” screen appears for ALL quiz outcomes, including 5/5.
if score == 5/5:
show the date coupon first
then automatically continue to the valentine question screen
if score < 5/5:
skip the coupon
directly show the valentine question screen
ensure the valentine question is always the final interaction of the app.

acceptanceCriteria: Completing the quiz with score == 5 first shows the date coupon/perfect results UI, then transitions to the Valentine question screen without requiring the user to click a manual 'Continue' control.
Completing the quiz with score < 5 routes directly to the Valentine question screen and does not show the date coupon screen.

Once the Valentine question flow is shown, it remains the last interactive flow; the app does not auto-navigate away to another screen afterward (only explicit user actions like restart/retake are allowed).

requirements.text: Adjust the perfect-score results screen so it can trigger an automatic transition to the Valentine question flow after it is displayed, while keeping existing perfect-score content intact (including the coupon and redeem interaction).
acceptanceCriteria: The perfect-score screen still renders its existing 5/5 content (including coupon UI and redeem interaction) before the app transitions to the Valentine question screen.
The transition from the perfect-score screen to the Valentine question screen occurs automatically (no additional required user click beyond the existing redeem behavior).
The Valentine question screen shown after the 5/5 path is the same Valentine prompt/interaction used for the <5 path.

constraints: Frontend must not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not add new backend services or databases; keep the app as a frontend-driven flow (backend/main.mo remains unchanged unless strictly necessary).
nonGoals: Changing quiz questions, scoring rules, or option animations.
Changing the Valentine question/celebration copy or interaction mechanics beyond what is required to make the flow appear for all outcomes and be final.
Adding new authentication requirements or gating any screens behind login.
